description: In message.rs::extract_headers, folded header continuation lines are unfolded by: last.1.push(' '); last.1.push_str(line.trim()). RFC 5322 §2.2.3 says the CRLF+WSP should be replaced with a single SP. The code appends a space then the trimmed continuation, which matches the spec. However trim() removes ALL leading and trailing whitespace from the continuation line, not just the leading WSP that indicates folding. If a header value contains intentional leading whitespace within a continuation (e.g. structured fields where indentation is significant), the extra trim() would strip it. Low-severity: most Sieve scripts only use Contains/Is matching on header values, where this whitespace difference is negligible.
title: sieve-native: extract_headers folds continuation by appending trimmed line with leading space
